video_title: 10 frases con MUSTN'T o DON'T HAVE TO. ¿Aciertas todas? ⚠️
video_description: Prohibido o no necesario: mustn't y don't have to no son iguales. ⚠️
title: Elige la correcta
intro: [curious] Elige la palabra que va en el hueco. Tienes unos segundos.

items.sentence: You ____ wear a seatbelt. It's the law.
You ____ tell anyone. It's a secret!
She ____ wear a uniform at school.
You ____ come if you don't want to.

verdict: Tres aciertos, nivel básico. Siete, intermedio. Diez, experto de verdad.
outro: [curious] ¿En cuál fallaste? Dímelo en los comentarios.
english_phrases: You mustn't smoke here. It's forbidden.
It's Sunday, I don't have to work.
You have to wear a seatbelt. It's the law.
We don't have to hurry. We have time.
You mustn't tell anyone. It's a secret!
She has to wear a uniform at school.
You don't have to come if you don't want to.
I must remember to call her.
Visitors must not feed the animals.
full_script: [curious] Elige la palabra que va en el hueco. Tienes unos segundos. You mustn't smoke here. It's forbidden. It's Sunday, I don't have to work. You have to wear a seatbelt. It's the law. Ahora, nivel intermedio. We don't have to hurry. We have time. You mustn't tell anyone. It's a secret! She has to wear a uniform at school. You don't have to come if you don't want to. Y ahora, nivel experto. I must remember to call her. Visitors must not feed the animals. You must be joking! Tres aciertos, nivel básico. Siete, intermedio. Diez, experto de verdad. [curious] ¿En cuál fallaste? Dímelo en los comentarios.
